a1_mechanism.detail: Delegates to derive_run_features(list(FEATURE_COLS)) which returns 53 kept features. sp_proj_era_home and sp_proj_era_away are NOT in FEATURE_COLS (they are runtime-attached by build_side_frame / attach_projection_levels, not raw features), so derive_run_features never sees them. The drift/coverage emitter calls run_engine_feature_cols() at explainability.py:733/746 to get its enumeration list — sp_proj_era is absent from that list.

a2_emit_path.detail: The drift step uses decided = _decided_snapshot (the pre-slate snapshot from get_decided_frame(games)). run_engine_daily() internally calls attach_projection_levels on its OWN copy inside the try block (run_engine.py:1976), but the drift step's frame is the un-attached snapshot — it NEVER sees sp_proj_era columns. Even if the enumeration list included sp_proj_era, the columns would be missing from the drift frame (compute_feature_drift skips columns not in the frame at explainability.py:522-523). This is BOTH an enumeration gap AND a structural gap (pre-attach drift frame).

a3_model_inventory_vs_drift.model_inputs: 53 derive_run_features kept columns (24 restored diffs + 29 kept) + 2 P1 projection level inputs (sp_proj_era_home, sp_proj_era_away) = 55 model-input columns total. The model trains on the P1-attached view: build_side_frame appends sp_proj_era_{opp} per side at run_engine.py:247-252, and run_engine_daily calls attach_projection_levels at run_engine.py:1976 before the OOF walk.
a3_model_inventory_vs_drift.drift_enumeration: 53 rows in run_engine_feature_drift_20260905.csv (no sp_proj_era). 106 rows in run_engine_feature_coverage_20260905.csv (53 features x 2 windows, no sp_proj_era).

audit.a4_verdict: enumeration_gap + structural_gap (pre-attach drift frame). NOT deliberate exclusion — there is no documentation anywhere excluding sp_proj_era from monitoring. The gap existed because the drift emitter's feature list was never extended when 8cb4efc attached the projection, AND the drift path uses a pre-attach frame.
